name: core.openwop.connections.cohere-rerank
description: Cohere Rerank connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider for the KB retrieval pipeline's EXTERNAL reranker (ADR 0351 Phase 4 / CSG-KB-8): a collection whose retrieval config selects `rerank:{kind:'connection'}` reranks its hybrid candidates through Cohere's /v2/rerank with the tenant's connected key, resolved through the connections broker (KMS-enveloped, rotatable) and dispatched over the brokered-egress spine (SSRF-guarded, no-redirect, bounded timeout). Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7). A rerank failure degrades HONESTLY to the local deterministic reranker, labeled on the search response.
